title: Data on Non-emergency and Non-critical Admissions to Public Hospitals and Hospitalisation Insurance Claims Made
what_it_is: Data on Non-emergency and Non-critical Admissions to Public Hospitals and Hospitalisation Insurance Claims Made

sections.label: Non-urgent but medically necessary admissions
sections.summary: About 20% of public hospital admissions are medically necessary though non-urgent, can tap MediSave and MediShield Life, and are managed through right pricing and post-discharge care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Some patients have medical conditions that are non-urgent and yet inpatient care is medically necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: They account for about 20% of all public hospital admissions, which has been a stable percentage over the past 10 years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: As these admissions are medically necessary, they can tap on MediSave and/or MediShield Life.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To minimise such over-staying in hospitals, we try our best to right price and right site patients.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This includes improving and expanding our Transitional Care Facilities and home care services to provide post-discharge care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We need to be very careful about offering incentives to reward non-claims.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: It can discourage some, especially the lower-income, from seeking medically necessary care.

sections.label: Ramping up Transitional Care Facilities
sections.summary: Transitional Care Facilities are being ramped up and expanded, and a suite of homecare services is being ensured to address post-discharge needs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Indeed, it is something that we have been looking into, as mentioned in my reply.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I had said that we are already ramping up and looking into our Transitional Care Facilities – which are already in place, but we are ramping up and expanding.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: We are also making sure that there is a suite of homecare services that will help address some of the needs, post-discharge.
